[14] DOCTOR: Peshab mein jalan hai kya?
[15] PATIENT: Nahi nahi, burning, hmm, urination nahi hai...
[16] DOCTOR: Bhookh theek se lagti hai?
[17] PATIENT: Haan, haan, bhookh, uh, kam, uh, lag rahi hai.
[18] DOCTOR: Toh, thermometer se dekha tha kuch?
[19] PATIENT: Woh, haan, haan, ghar pe thermometer se 99.5 tha.
[20] DOCTOR: Pehle se koi bimari? Sugar, BP kuch?
[21] PATIENT: Hmm, nahi, kuch nahi hai.
[22] DOCTOR: Chaliye, ek baar check kar lete hain.
[23] PATIENT: Theek hai.
[24] DOCTOR: Bukhar 101.4 degree hai.
[25] DOCTOR: Pulse 82 hai.
[26] DOCTOR: Symptoms se toh viral fever jaisa lag raha hai.
[27] DOCTOR: Pehli dawai Paracetamol 650 hai.
[28] PATIENT: Kitni baar leni hai?
[29] DOCTOR: Dekhiye, 3 baar, 3 days tak, khane ke baad.
[30] DOCTOR: Toh, CBC karwa lena, report ke saath aaiye.
[31] PATIENT: Khane peene, arre, mein kuch parhez?
[32] DOCTOR: Khoob paani peeyen, dehydration na ho.
[33] DOCTOR: Tala hua khana mat khaiye, halka khana, achha, lijiye. Aaram kijiye, kaam se chhutti le lijiye.
[34] PATIENT: Theek hai.
[35] DOCTOR: 3 din mein theek na lage toh wapas dikhaiye.
[36] PATIENT: Ji, theek hai.
[37] PATIENT: Dh- Dhanyavaad doctor.
[38] DOCTOR: Get well, matlab, soon.
